scope: programmatic rendered articulation-symbol experiments; not end-to-end OMR accuracy

experiments.name: staccato_presence_guard
experiments.reason: At zero observed false accepts, independent correct-addition coverage was below the minimum useful deployment gate; duration dots, dust and nearby staccato marks remained dominant confounders.

experiments.name: shared_tenuto_accent_shape_model
experiments.reason: Tenuto marks remained inseparable from staff fragments and short horizontal print defects at useful selective coverage; sharing one classifier diluted the safer accent geometry.

experiments.name: accent_without_direction_balance
experiments.reason: Single diagonal fragments entered the high-confidence tail before opposing-slope balance features were added.

experiments.name: articulation_deletion_or_class_substitution
experiments.reason: A presence-only local model cannot prove deletion or distinguish accent, tenuto and staccato substitutions safely.

accepted_replacement.responsibility: veto-only source-crop confirmation for empty articulation set to one accent addition
accepted_replacement.excluded: staccato, tenuto, articulation deletion, class substitution, stacked articulations and general articulation recognition
